title: Supplementary material to "Integrating a global glacier model into local hydrological modeling: Impacts on melt contributions"
abstract: This Supplementary Material contains figures illustrating characteristics of the study sites (Figures S1-S2) and daily observed and simulated streamflow time series for each catchment and model configuration (Figures S3-S16).It further includes example scatter plots (Figure S17) and residual plots (Figure S18).Figures S19-S22 show the distributions of snow-related parameters and the precipitation correction factor.In addition, three tables (Tables S1-S3) present supplementary results referenced in the main text.The code used to produce the figures will be made available in the repository.
problem: This paper addresses the challenge of accurately modeling melt contributions in local hydrological simulations, as standard models often lack the sophisticated glacier components that can be provided by integrating a global glacier model.
method: This study integrates a global glacier model into a local hydrological model to improve the simulation of streamflow and melt contributions in glacierized catchments.
task: The task is to evaluate the impact of integrating a global glacier model into local hydrological modeling on the simulation of streamflow and glacier melt contributions in various catchments.
innovation: This paper integrates a global glacier model into a local hydrological model to evaluate the impacts of different model complexities on simulating streamflow and glacier melt contributions across several Swiss catchments.
